source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Identity Theft
description: Targeted take-over of an identity of certain satellite lifecycle actors, by acquiring their personal items, information or other artifacts which would allow adversaries to pose as those actors. This may grant adversaries access to processes, information or even facilites where they could perpetrate multitude of actions whose results can compromise each aspect of CIA triad of satellite lifecycle.

projection.lifecycle_rule: ET-P-LC-01 (legacy tuple L field; Annex C has no lifecycle column)

derivation_provenance.note: candidate_lifecycle copies the legacy tuple L field {3,4,5,6,7}; ENISA STL 2025 Annex C has no lifecycle column, so the basis is the legacy tuple, not the Annex

claims.rationale: Posing as legitimate actors to gain access.
